svg.title: One observer architecture, two physical branches
svg.desc: A source-selected twelve-port carrier federation settles a public normal form. Authenticated read-from provenance generates a finite event poset and its canonical longest-parent-chain source height. Independently, a real axis and the exact rank-three source Gram quotient define a four-dimensional ambient carrier with Lorentz signature plus-minus-minus-minus, and every unit source direction gives a future-null direction. Positive timeScale times source height enters only as the temporal coordinate of an event placement; it is not physical time, and event spatial readback remains supplied. An edge-speed bound maps generated precedence into the cone, while converse support makes the placement faithful. A separate minimal tensor theorem uses nine supplied source-direction balances, Ward and Bianchi conservation, and connectedness to derive all-null balance and one finite Einstein-form ambiguity. Provenance supplies none of the tensor fields, discrete step, or balance laws. A physical effective manifold requires signal-causal agreement, count-to-volume calibration, source-selected refinement convergence, manifoldlikeness, stable dimension and topology, and curvature convergence. Smooth Einstein dynamics additionally requires physical curvature, stress, coupling, vacuum, and scale. A separate physical bridge leads to the icosahedral current and Standard Model branch.

g.text: schedule-independent only under the consensus receipts
source height enters only F(e)=(τh,x); edge/converse → order↔cone
